scope: AIOC-only preimplementation contract closure; no Multiversal-app runtime implementation or hosted activation

authority_model.invariant: Deployment profile chooses where provider-neutral ports execute; it does not change owner-domain authority, canonical identifiers, durable-history semantics, authorization rules or recovery rules.
authority_model.authoritative_executor_role: Exactly one current authoritative executor per governed Campaign/Session mutation context. In local-host mode it is the installed host process selected by the governed Campaign/Session. In managed-service mode it is the selected SMB-01 service boundary.
authority_model.server_term_disposition: Existing SMB-01 'server' command authority is a semantic executor role, not a requirement that the executor be remote, cloud-hosted or paid.
authority_model.durable_truth: Authoritative owner-domain records, ordered Events and checkpoints remain durable truth. Realtime/presence/transport delivery never becomes canonical state.
authority_model.split_brain_rule: A local-host and managed-service profile may not both accept authoritative mutation for the same Campaign/Session epoch. Profile transition requires governed handoff/recovery evidence before the new executor can accept commands.

local_authoritative_host.durable_store: installed local SQLite/local-store adapter, with exact transactional/schema mechanics deferred to PCV-I02
local_authoritative_host.identity: PCV-I01A local proof-of-possession + canonical A3/identity-device records
local_authoritative_host.entitlement: local EntitlementPort adapter over trusted durable entitlement/grant records
local_authoritative_host.session: canonical A5 launch snapshot + A5 Session shell + AuthoritativeSessionPort semantics
local_authoritative_host.realtime: local/direct delivery adapter only; advisory and recoverable from durable sequence/checkpoint
local_authoritative_host.checkpoint: local durable checkpoint adapter over the canonical Session history

managed_service.identity: SMB-01 IdentityPort adapter preserving provider-independent subject IDs
managed_service.session: same canonical A5 launch snapshot + A5 Session shell + AuthoritativeSessionPort semantics

IdentityPort.local_adapter_semantics: Resolve/maintain canonical A3 subject+identity mapping and verified local credential/session from PCV-I01A; no provider SDK or device identity authority.
IdentityPort.managed_adapter_semantics: SMB-01 selected OIDC/provider adapter maps external identity to the same provider-independent canonical subject.

EntitlementPort.local_adapter_semantics: Evaluate locally trusted subscription/sponsored/campaign-grant records through canonical entitlement semantics and emit a versioned decision reference.
EntitlementPort.managed_adapter_semantics: SMB-01 selected entitlement service evaluates the same grant/capability model.

PersistencePort.local_adapter_semantics: Persist canonical owner records, Events, operation receipts and checkpoints through the installed durable store; transaction/migration details are PCV-I02.
PersistencePort.managed_adapter_semantics: SMB-01 selected PostgreSQL persistence adapter implements the same logical owner records and invariants.

SessionCommandPort.local_adapter_semantics: Installed authoritative host validates authenticated subject, current membership/permission/entitlement, expected version and idempotency before applying a canonical command.
SessionCommandPort.managed_adapter_semantics: SMB-01 authoritative service applies the same command contract.

RealtimePort.local_adapter_semantics: Direct/local-network transport publishes already-authorized durable Events and resumes from durable sequence; delivery loss cannot erase canonical history.
RealtimePort.managed_adapter_semantics: SMB-01 websocket-advisory delivery follows the same ordered durable Event history.

CheckpointPort.local_adapter_semantics: Create/load content-bound durable checkpoints from canonical Session state and ordered Event sequence.
CheckpointPort.managed_adapter_semantics: SMB-01 selected checkpoint adapter persists/retrieves the same checkpoint semantics.

ObjectStoragePort.local_adapter_semantics: Local governed asset/blob storage reference adapter where required; never owner-domain semantic authority.

TelemetryPort.local_adapter_semantics: Local diagnostics/telemetry sink with hidden/private content excluded by policy; absence of remote telemetry never blocks authoritative play.

online_semantics.definition: online=true means the current authoritative executor for the requested operation is reachable now and can perform the required fresh authorization/evaluation plus durable authoritative read or commit. It does not mean Internet access, cloud availability, paid-service availability or navigator.onLine=true.
online_semantics.managed_service_example: configured managed authoritative service endpoint passes its governed reachability/health boundary
online_false_when: fresh authorization/entitlement evaluation cannot be obtained when required
durable authoritative mutation cannot be committed for a mutation request
online_semantics.cached_projection_rule: Offline/cached UI may render previously authorized safe projections where their owning contract permits it, but may not set online=true or authorize protected mutation/entry.
online_semantics.browser_network_hint_rule: Generic OS/browser connectivity signals are hints only and never satisfy the authoritative-executor reachability test.

entitlement_composition.local_baseline: A local profile always derives free baseline capability from canonical evaluation. Subscriber/sponsored/campaign-premium capability requires locally trusted, durable grant records; caller booleans or transport claims are never entitlement evidence.
entitlement_composition.handshake_rule: Campaign/Session entry and remote join consume an entitlementDecisionReference plus entitlementRulesetVersion produced by the current authoritative executor from locally measured/trusted entitlement state. A joining client cannot echo the host offer or self-assert premium capability.
entitlement_composition.expiry_rule: A decision is stale at nextChangeAt, grant revocation, ruleset/version change or authoritative source revision invalidation, whichever occurs first. Protected use requiring entitlement then re-evaluates before mutation/entry.
entitlement_composition.profile_parity: Equivalent trusted entitlement/grant records and ruleset versions produce equivalent effective entitlement across local-host and managed-service profiles.

canonical_creation_path: create the canonical A5 Session shell referencing that snapshot
append ordered durable Events and checkpoints
deliver permitted realtime projections from the durable history
session_owner_composition.pcv03_host_session_disposition: Any PCV-03 host runtime object is a transient executor/projection keyed to canonical A5 sessionId + launchSnapshotId + revision/sequence. It cannot mint an independent Session identity, membership ledger, Event history or checkpoint lineage.
session_owner_composition.transition_rule: A5 pause/resume/close and Session revision remain canonical across deployment profiles.
session_owner_composition.reconnect_rule: SMB-02 reconnect resumes from canonical checkpoint + durable ordered Events + current authorization/entitlement. Device/transport state never replaces Session authority.

profile_transition.mutation_gate: Target executor remains read-only/unavailable for authoritative mutation until the handoff confirms the same canonical history and establishes a strictly newer authorityEpoch.
profile_transition.no_automatic_merge: Divergent local-host and managed-service histories are a conflict requiring governed recovery; they are never merged by timestamp, transport arrival order or client preference.

frozen_semantics_here: one canonical logical owner model across deployment profiles
persistence_and_transaction_boundary.not_authorized_here: No concrete SQLite schema/migration, PostgreSQL migration, secret-store implementation or runtime adapter code.

external_sanity_checks.use: generic browser connectivity cannot prove a particular authoritative service is reachable; LAN connectivity can exist without Internet reachability
managed persistence preserves all-or-nothing durable mutation semantics; concrete transaction implementation remains PCV-I02

runtime_boundary.next_runtime_destination: PCV-03A after PCV-I02 through PCV-I06 predecessor closure
